known_outcome: The complete live CCMC API snapshot has no matching BTRboard/BTR Board product or assessment-holder entry among 462 records. This finding is limited to that snapshot and does not establish whether another evaluation exists.
review_focus: Distinguish manufacturer claims/instructions from a third-party evaluation or code assessment.
Check the exact OSB, FIRE-X or RESIST variant and its documented layers and fastening details.
Do not infer a CCMC assessment, code edition, listing scope or performance from product marketing.
Ask for the project assembly, jurisdiction/code edition and complete product-specific independent evidence.
